headline: Microsoft drops 'Copilot+ PC' brand, unveils Copilot super app
summary: Microsoft is retiring the 'Copilot+ PC' hardware branding, with new Surface laptops dropping the label, while separately unveiling a revamped Copilot 'super app' that bundles chat, coding and agents, adds Office integration and third-party frontier model support, and rebrands its Scout assistant as Autopilot. ZDNet notes pricing for the new app is still 'evolving.'
